ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with localized high-intensity (white) regions at the distal tips and lower leading edges; estimated ratio approximately 90:10 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central area consists of a single contiguous low-intensity dark mass; high-intensity focal spots are mapped to the extreme lateral tips (rosettes) and sparse mottling on the lower trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees between the converging lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels, creating a jagged profile across both left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, characterized by a steady outward and upward curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel formations (barnacle rosettes) located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle colonization/encrustation visible on the outer fluke tips; localized white pigmentation/scarring on the posterior edge of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged serration pattern on the trailing edge is highly asymmetrical in peak distribution.
